Container.Name: amy-ai-platform
Container.Overview:
Amy AI Platform: a self-hosted, customizable AI platform. Runs local models on your NVIDIA GPU (bundled Ollama), exposes an OpenAI-compatible API for your other apps, and includes a web chat UI. Part of the open-source Amy WorkspAIce suite.
GPU: requires the "Nvidia Driver" plugin. Without a GPU, remove "--runtime=nvidia" from Extra Parameters. API key: printed in the container log on first start and saved to appdata/secrets/api_key.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: All persistent data: settings, secrets, and downloaded models (models can be large; consider a cache/SSD pool).

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank to auto-generate on first start (see container log).

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: GPU UUID(s) from the Nvidia Driver plugin page, or 'all'.

Config.Name: Use Bundled Ollama
Config.Description: Run the built-in Ollama engine. Set false if you use an external Ollama server.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Bundled Ollama by default. Point at another Ollama server if not bundled.

Config.Name: SearXNG URL
Config.Description: Optional, recommended for web search: your SearXNG container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080 (enable 'json' under search.formats in its settings.yml). Without it, Amy falls back to DuckDuckGo.

Config.Name: Brave Search API key
Config.Description: Optional alternative web search provider (free tier at brave.com/search/api).

Config.Name: GitHub token
Config.Description: Optional: lets agent mode clone private repos and push. Use a fine-grained token limited to the repos you want the agent to touch.

Config.Name: Context length
Config.Description: Tokens of context for chat models. Agent mode needs at least 16384; more uses more GPU memory.
